say:1:1841114001:1.text: There's something wrong with this castle.
say:1:1841114001:1.male: There's something wrong with this castle.
say:1:1841114001:1.female: There's something wrong with this castle.

say:2:1841114002:1.text: The layout, the furniture, every decoration... even that chandelier in the middle of the hall. Every part of this place puts me on edge.
say:2:1841114002:1.source_cn: 从布局、装潢，再到装饰品，还有大厅中央的吊灯……每一个...
say:2:1841114002:1.male: The layout, the furniture, every decoration... even that chandelier in the middle of the hall. Every part of this place puts me on edge.
say:2:1841114002:1.female: The layout, the furniture, every decoration... even that chandelier in the middle of the hall. Every part of this place puts me on edge.

say:3:1841114003:1.text: Normally, the art in a castle tells you something about the person who lives there—their tastes, their personality, the little choices they made.
say:3:1841114003:1.source_cn: 依照常理来说，通过城堡内的装饰画理应可以看出城堡主人的...
say:3:1841114003:1.male: Normally, the art in a castle tells you something about the person who lives there—their tastes, their personality, the little choices they made.
say:3:1841114003:1.female: Normally, the art in a castle tells you something about the person who lives there—their tastes, their personality, the little choices they made.

say:4:1841114004:1.text: But this place gives you nothing.
say:4:1841114004:1.source_cn: 但在这里，什么都看不出。
say:4:1841114004:1.male: But this place gives you nothing.
say:4:1841114004:1.female: But this place gives you nothing.

say:5:1841114005:1.text: Tephesia... It's like she went out of her way to make sure no one could figure her out.
say:5:1841114005:1.source_cn: 苔佩希……似乎根本不打算让人读懂她。
say:5:1841114005:1.male: Tephesia... It's like she went out of her way to make sure no one could figure her out.
say:5:1841114005:1.female: Tephesia... It's like she went out of her way to make sure no one could figure her out.
